hook: A monochrome still image captured by a U.S. military optical system depicting a small, dark, circular object in the upper right quadrant of the frame, with a mountain range in the background and a central crosshair reticle — submitted by the FBI to AARO in 2025 with no accompanying mission report.
why_it_matters: This image represents one of the rare instances where the FBI formally submitted a UAP report derived from a military sensor system directly to AARO, indicating inter-agency reporting pipelines are functioning for UAP events. The operator's documented inability to positively identify the object, combined with the absence of a mission report and pre-submission redactions, limits analytical resolution. The corrupted timestamp further degrades the evidentiary value of this record, a recurring data quality issue in UAP reporting.

key_findings.finding: A small, dark, circular object was observed in the upper right quadrant of the frame against a mountainous background, captured by a U.S. military system in the Western United States.
The original imagery was altered with redactions by the originating agency before submission to AARO, and no accompanying mission report was provided, constraining any contextual analysis.
The operator of the military system reported being unable to positively identify the UAP, satisfying the basic definitional threshold for UAP reporting under current AARO guidelines.
The date displayed in the image is incorrect due to the recording system's date/time not being properly configured, rendering the embedded timestamp unreliable as an evidentiary anchor.

The FBI acted as the submitting agency to AARO rather than the originating military component, suggesting the image passed through at least one inter-agency transfer before entering the formal UAP resolution process.

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: The document was formally submitted by the FBI to AARO as part of the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office's UAP reporting and resolution mission.
The image was derived from an unspecified U.S. military system, which could encompass reconnaissance or surveillance platforms, though no specific program is named.
